description: Missing resource returns Err before successful Ok.
Explicit if/else returns Result on both branches.
Qualified Result constructor calls are accepted.
An inverted positive branch may return Ok before the failure Err.
Ok/Err names exist but are not terminal outcomes.
One relevant failure path uses Err and another does not.
Result returns occur only after a terminal return or false guard.
Err after a raise cannot repair the expected failure path.
Failure returns Err but success returns a bare value.
